_comment: Injected copy of the DATA repo's export-contract.json, used only by the offline CI harness (PRD 17.4: 'Pipeline offline unit tests inject a fixture config'). It differs from production in exactly one value: required_mode is 'all', because the synthetic end-to-end exists to exercise every writer, and a fixture that required 'none' would let the whole export path be skipped while CI stayed green. Every other field carries the published contract's value (the prose _comment_* keys are dropped); identities are checked for equality by Export::Mode, so a drift here fails loudly rather than mislabeling an asset.
